messages:
Priya: Quick heads-up — Snowflake + Databricks + Qdrant partners want a coordinated announcement for the new multi-surface connector (Marketplace listing + Partner Connect + on-prem bundle). Can we align timelines and who's owning each artifact?
Liam: I'm happy to take the marketplace listing draft. ETA end of week for the copy + screenshots.
Diego: I'll own the Partner Connect flow for Databricks (notebook + quickstart) — need the sample dataset and runtime config. Can someone confirm the connector package name we should publish?
Priya: Proposal: 'redwood-connector-dataflow' for Marketplace and 'redwood-db-connector' for Databricks bundle to keep names distinct. Thoughts?
Sarah: Works for me. For Snowflake listing we need the ingestion diagram and compliance blurb (EU residency + KMS). I'll draft the diagram.
Jordan: On DGX/on-prem hardware packaging — ops will need a validated binary + compatibility matrix (driver versions, CUDA/cuDNN). Diego, can you include a smoke test command we can run in the validation lab?
Diego: Yep. Adding a quick curl for the adapter healthcheck: `curl -sS -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://adapter.local/health | jq .status`
Marketplace Bot: marketplace-draft created: https://marketplace.internal/redwood/drafts/12345 (auto-tag: partners/snowflake/databricks/qdrant) :white_check_mark:
Priya: Nice — can we lock an embargo window? Partners prefer coordinated public on Monday 09:00 PT next week. That gives us 6 business days.
Liam: Timeline ok from marketing. Need final screenshots by Thursday EOD. Also request partner logos and PR contact from Snowflake & Databricks legal.
Sarah: Snowflake legal gave a green light on logos, but they require the marketplace listing to include a brief data flow statement: "No customer data leaves the account unless explicitly configured". Add that to the compliance blurb.
Jordan: Ops note — for on-prem bundle we'll provide a tarball + install script. Can we get a SHA256 and a small verification script in the repo? Example: `sha256sum connector.tar.gz` and `./verify.sh connector.tar.gz expected_sha256`.
Diego: I'll add a `verify.sh` and a minimal acceptance test: ingest 10 rows -> query vector -> assert similarity > 0.85. Will put sample data in `samples/retail_small.csv`.
Priya: Action items: Liam -> marketplace draft copy + screenshots (due Thu EOD). Diego -> Partner Connect notebook + verify script (due Fri EOD). Sarah -> compliance blurb + diagram (due Wed EOD). Jordan -> ops packaging + SHA (due Fri EOD). I'll collect partner PR contacts and draft embargo email.
Liam: Quick Q — do we want a joint demo env for press? Could spin up a time-limited shared workspace in staging.
Sarah: Yes please. If we do, we need an isolation checklist (no customer PII, limited retention). I'll prepare.
Diego: For the demo env I'll add a seeded dataset and tokens that expire after 48h.
Jordan: Ops can stand up a test cluster (DGX) on request, but need the exact CUDA + driver matrix by tomorrow to preinstall.
Priya: Noted. Also: decide on a single canonical CTA for all listings — `Get started` -> links to our Partner Connect notebook and marketplace listing. Keep it consistent.
Liam: I'll standardize the CTAs.
Sarah: One more thing — telemetry. Partners asked for minimal telemetry wording. Proposed: "Basic usage metrics (latency, request counts) are collected for performance and support; no payloads or PII are retained." Approve?
Priya: Approve. Add it to the compliance blurb.
Jordan: Cool. I'll start packaging and post a link to the tarball in this thread when ready.
Diego: I'll open PRs for the notebook + verify script and ping you all.
Priya: Thanks team — smoothing out logistics now. Will send embargo notice to partners once we have final assets. :rocket:
